goal: Return a bounded owned copy of the primary MDLX/MSET/weapon asset bytes with selected-source provenance, before any native ResourceEntry or Panacea remaster parser runs.

api.manifest: Exact retail/Panacea fingerprints; resolved UTF-16 roots after /kh2; ordered retail HED/PKG descriptors with per-provider decodeEnabled; prefix/encoding policy; platformTransformEnabled; optional validated startup inventory identity. Caller labels manifest as offline or runtime-bound.
api.result: OwnedAssetBytes { ReadOnlyMemory<byte> Bytes, ProviderKind, SourceStamp, RelativeName, MatchedNameBytes, HED ordinal/record offset or standalone record, MetadataHash, DecodedHash, ManifestHash, BindingStrength }
api.ownership: Reader alone owns its buffers and file handles. Never pass game pointers or delegate to native loaders. Enforce AssetReadLimits before allocation, arithmetic, decompression and recursive BAR parsing.

primaryProviderOrder.condition: Only exact supported Panacea manifest. Existing nondirectory wins before any loose source.
primaryProviderOrder.format: Standalone16-byte PKG header +48*remasterCount metadata +original encoded payload; no HED required.

primaryProviderOrder.condition: Only after all higher priority candidates are absent.
primaryProviderOrder.format: First matching digest row within first successful provider; exact name then lowercase final slash component inside each provider.

pathContract: Accept the native relative asset name before resource-prefix concatenation. Do not hash absolute root paths. Validate it as a relative path without traversal/device/alternate-stream syntax.

Hash exact narrow name bytes. For ASCII game asset names, lowercase only A..Z in the final slash component on fallback; do not lowercase all directories or search all exact hashes before every lowercase hash.

Panacea roots are resolved UTF-16 strings from mod_path/dev_path/extract_path after appending /kh2; optional roots remain disabled when empty. Relative configured roots require an explicit process working-directory basis.

Settings text is not sufficient to prove running roots. Runtime binding would need a read-only copied, bounded root/provider snapshot and supported hook fingerprint; this proposal does not add that bridge mechanism.
Unknown provider, locale-dependent/non-ASCII asset-name ambiguity or unverified remap returns Unsupported/Ambiguous; never silently substitutes vanilla.

recordContract.header: Little-endian int32 rawSize@0, remasterCount@4, mode@8, creation@12; metadataLength=16+48*count with checked64-bit arithmetic.
recordContract.payloadStart: Retail HED record offset + metadataLength; standalone raw record offset0 + metadataLength.
recordContract.storage: For decoded game packages / Panacea raw records, rawSize<=16 reads rawSize unchanged. If rawSize>16: positive mode gives stored length and requires prefix transform then zlib; mode -1 gives rawSize plus transform; mode -2 gives plain rawSize. Reject unsupported modes, impossible spans and excessive allocations.
recordContract.providerDecodeGate: Retail object+292 can disable both transform and inflation regardless mode. Built-in six KH2 packages have true; SettingMenu false. The Core reader must carry this property or limit its supported package class; do not globally assume all providers decode.
recordContract.transformGate: Nonzero retail platform global79CFCC disables1062B0. Default supported manifest may require expected Steam state0; otherwise explicitly model it. Panacea calls this same transform.
recordContract.integrity: Use ReadExactly, stream-end and exact decoded length; validate zlib checksum. Existing AssetPackageCodec already supplies bounded prefix transform/inflate for supported retail modes. Refactor its record parser to accept a bounded standalone record; never fake a HED and bypass identity checks.
recordContract.recordBounds: Retail HED contains16-byte name digest, signed64 record offset@16, storedLength@24, originalLength@28. Host must reject negative/overflowing/out-of-record spans and duplicate ambiguity rather than skipping a selected malformed provider.
recordContract.remasterScope: Primary bytes only. Validate metadata span and physical placement; do not treat successful primary decode as proof that remastered textures, model bones, meshes or motion tracks are valid.

failureContract: Only NotFound/Directory advances provider priority. AccessDenied, short read, changed source, invalid record, decode error and resource limits reject the selected source.
A zero-size or invalid higher-priority override never falls through to a valid lower-priority asset.
Use file identity+length+metadata fingerprint, hold read handles where practical and recheck before publishing the owned result. Return a content digest, not just a path/size.
Expected-byte checks for native functions do not freeze provider contents, startup inventory, cached headers or foreign hooks.
nativeUseGate: The host reader is directly useful for offline validation and diagnosis.

Using its success as a preconstructor authorization additionally requires a runtime-bound provider manifest, proof that the native package lookup resolves a valid metadata owner for selected overrides, and prevention/detection of changed higher-priority candidates.

The bytes consumed by the subsequent asynchronous native load must be the validated bytes or be revalidated under an equivalent atomic source contract. A disk hash checked before NativeBegin alone leaves TOCTOU.
Native constructor allocation failures and deeper mesh/bone/MSET/remaster validation remain later conditions; no universal crash-free claim follows.
testsToImplement: All five priority levels; dev versus mod versus extract; raw always wins; absent versus unreadable/truncated/corrupt selected override.
Exact digest and basename-only lowercase in each package before moving to the next; case-sensitive directory bytes; duplicates; cached-manifest invalidation.
Standalone raw record with0/N remasters; mode-2/-1/positive; sizes0/16/17; decodeEnabled false; transformEnabled false; malformed/negative/overflowing lengths.
Short header/table/payload; truncated zlib; trailing output; checksum failure; unsupported padding; configured allocation/depth limits.
Source/config changes, replacement file identity, new higher-priority appearance and no silent retail fallback.
New loose file absent from startup metadata inventory must not be marked safe for native registered loading.
Read-only owned output remains valid after source handles close; no game/native functions invoked.
decisionRequired: Parent decides Core implementation and any later bridge snapshot/handoff. No product file changed in this research round.
